== Strategy ==

I have reciently found good use for A Jedi's Resilence.  All of the Characters, except for Yoda and Leia, have a built in lightsaber.  I can drop Qui-gon off to a site that he can kill off the opponent's characters with his blade. Draw a battle destiny, get more damage and then sack him and bring him back with A Jedi's Resilence.

In response to using Off The Edge, I was going from cards I own, and i have no off the edge.  Also, I usually retrieve with Either Way You Win combined with Reflection.  It is a large enough retrieval system for every game I have played.  And thank you for the advice
